END-TO-END MULTI-AGENT TERMINAL, PARAMETRIC TEXT-TO-CAD, NOTE SYNTHESIS & WEB EXTRACTION (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Parallel Agent Terminal (cmux ★28.9k): Orchestrate 10+ concurrent coding agents in vertical Ghostty tabs with native completion alerts.
2. Parametric Hardware Design (text-to-cad ★27.3k): Generate and iterate manufacturable 3D CAD assemblies from Python specs.
3. Capture-First Knowledge Base (note-gen ★13.0k): Distill scattered field records and screenshots into local Git-backed Markdown.
4. Deterministic Web Extraction (trafilatura ★7.1k): Convert noisy web pages into clean Markdown/JSON for RAG at zero API cost.
